prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1267; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claimant reported a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was stopped at the light when struck from behind. Claimant states she felt immediate pain in her right knee after the impact. Police report requested. No attorney listed on file.

Entry 2: Recorded recorded statement from claimant. She reports the knee struck the dashboard during impact and she has limited bending since. Photos of both vehicles received. Damage appears consistent with a low-to-moderate speed impact. Claimant declined an ambulance at scene and was driven home by a family member.

Entry 3: Claimant provided medical records from urgent care visit. Diagnosis noted as soft tissue injury to the right knee with swelling. Treating provider recommended rest, ice, and a follow-up with an orthopedic specialist if symptoms persist. Physical therapy referral pending. Claimant confirmed she is not represented by counsel and has asked how the process works.

Entry 4: Reviewed the at-fault driver's liability coverage. Limits confirmed and accepted for this claim. Explained to claimant the general steps for a bodily injury claim, including how medical expenses and lost wages are documented. Claimant asked for a written summary, which was sent by mail.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant. She reports the knee is still swollen and stiff when climbing stairs. Orthopedic appointment scheduled for next week per her report. Remaining medical bills to be submitted once received. Claim remains open pending treatment outcome and documentation review.
